details: Kevin Warsh was confirmed by the US Senate as the 17th Federal Reserve Chair on May 13, succeeding Jerome Powell whose term ended May 15. The confirmation was divisive, occurring as the central bank grapples with elevated inflation and pressure from President Trump for lower interest rates. Warsh's appointment introduces uncertainty into future monetary policy, with analysts watching for shifts in the Fed's approach to inflation and economic growth.
title: Kevin Warsh confirmed as Fed Chair, signaling potential monetary shifts.

details: The US Senate Banking Committee advanced the "Clarity Act," a significant cryptocurrency market structure bill, on May 15 with a 15-9 bipartisan vote. This legislation aims to establish a comprehensive federal framework for crypto regulation, addressing stablecoin yield and expanding anti-money laundering requirements. The bill now proceeds to the full Senate and will need to be reconciled with a previously passed House version, facing further debate on investor protection and national security concerns.
title: Senate Committee advances "Clarity Act" for US crypto regulation.

details: The US Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) issued an alert on May 11, warning financial institutions about methods used by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) to evade sanctions. The alert highlights the use of shell companies, illicit oil sales, and digital assets, including stablecoins, to fund their activities. FinCEN provided red flags to help banks identify and report suspicious transactions, noting that Iranian digital asset activities linked to government entities could amount to billions annually.
title: FinCEN alerts banks to Iran's crypto use for sanctions evasion.

details: Oil prices experienced volatility following President Trump's rejection of Iran's peace proposals on May 11, with Brent crude climbing to $103-$105 a barrel due to concerns over the Strait of Hormuz, a critical oil shipping route. The ongoing conflict and threats to shipping lanes continue to raise fears of sustained high energy prices and global inflation. However, other reports from May 15 indicated easing US-Iran tensions and a projected fall in WTI crude oil prices for May, due to assurances regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. The situation remains fluid, contributing to market uncertainty.
title: US-Iran tensions create oil price volatility; conflicting reports on Strait.
